fact: The 2024 article states that section 72 of POPIA bars a responsible party transferring personal information to a foreign third party unless one of its conditions is met, that prior authorisation is needed for special or children's information to countries without adequate protection, and that POPIA makes no provision for pre-approved standard clauses or Regulator approval of agreements.
title: Cross-Border Data Flows and the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 - Part II: The Data Transfer Provision
